text: Load flow (ALP-EPC-00000-EL-STU-0001): network model of the grid (min / max short-circuit level, voltage range of DP-OWNR-0050), GSU, UAT, MV and LV systems for all HMB cases; check the bus voltages (0.95 to 1.05 pu), tap settings, transformer loading, cable and busduct loading, power factor at the connection point, and the export limit of DP-OWNR-0051.
